payout_quote: Los Angeles County jurors receive no compensation for the first day; from the second day, $15 per day plus one-way mileage reimbursement.
steps: Receive an LA County Superior Court jury summons
Receive $15/day plus one-way mileage starting on day two (nothing for day one)
catches: No pay at all for the first day — and most jurors serve only one day, earning $0.
California government employees are excluded from the fee (they get regular pay).
$15/day is far below a day's wages; this offsets costs, not income.
biggest_catch: Most jurors serve a single day and are paid nothing — the $15/day starts only on day two.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in LA County Superior Court.
timing: Computed at completion of service; mailed.
